+def _get_units_from_attrs(var) -> str:
+    """Extracts and formats the unit/s from a variable's attributes, if any
+    are present. Recognizes both the (preferred) CF convention ``units``
+    attribute and the more informal ``unit`` attribute.
+    """
+    if "units" in var.attrs:
+        units = var.attrs["units"]
+    elif "unit" in var.attrs:
+        units = var.attrs["unit"]
+    else:
+        return ""
+    return f" [{units}]"
+
